testcase.name: repeated encoding fields decode every layer in field order
a later identity field cannot hide an unsupported encoding
a truncated later gzip member cannot publish earlier members
gzip reports decoded progress before the next compressed fragment
inner deflate EOF cannot hide a corrupt outer gzip trailer
inner deflate EOF cannot hide an incomplete outer gzip trailer
repeated mixed encoding fields preserve order and empty list members
unknown repeated encoding fields reject even beside blank fields
repeated encoding fields cannot append to a decoded saved prefix
complete gzip members including empty members decode with one byte buffers
each member checks both its checksum and uncompressed size
gzip optional headers and their checksum are verified on later members
all nested layers complete with default and one byte buffers
deflate EOF rejects additional outer output rather than discarding it
deflate cannot complete while a preset dictionary is still required
gzip rejects trailing bytes that are not another complete member
valid identity and empty list entries retain decoded bytes
empty leading middle trailing gzip members and mixed layers are valid
206 identity lists append once and 200 encoding replaces saved prefix
206 encoding from byte zero decodes without a saved prefix
malformed first gzip headers bodies and trailers reject and remove files
new deflate rejection and malformed outer layers remove saved files
encoded progress total must describe decoded cumulative positions
